origin.description: Count words, commands, and environments in LaTeX text.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector of LaTeX lines.

origin.details: The counts follow the Kile word-count state machine. A comment starts at an unescaped percent sign. begin increments the environment count.
origin.value: A named integer vector: CharsWord, CharsCmdEnvir, CharsWhite, Words, Cmds, Envirs.
origin.example: s <- c("Lorem \\textbf{ipsum} dolor sit \\textit{amet}, consectetur adipisicing elit.", "\\begin{small}Proin nibh augue,\\end{small} suscipit a, scelerisque sed, lacinia in, mi.", ""); x <- stri_stats_latex(s); cat(paste0("stri_stats_latex(s)$Words returns ", x["Words"], " and Cmds returns ", x["Cmds"], ".\n"))

translation.description: Count words, commands, and environments in LaTeX text.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string or a list of LaTeX lines.

translation.details: The state machine follows stringi's Kile port. A missing line is skipped. A newline inside a line is an error. \\begin increments Envirs.
translation.value: A dict with CharsWord, CharsCmdEnvir, CharsWhite, Words, Cmds, and Envirs.
translation.example:
s = ["Lorem \\textbf{ipsum} dolor sit \\textit{amet}, consectetur adipisicing elit.", "\\begin{small}Proin nibh augue,\\end{small} suscipit a, scelerisque sed, lacinia in, mi.", ""]
x = stri_stats_latex(s)
print(f"stri_stats_latex(s)['Words'] returns {x['Words']} and Cmds returns {x['Cmds']}.")
